axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Resting Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)

disorder_counts = df.groupby('occupation')['sleep_disorder'].value_counts(normalize=True).mul(100).rename('percentage').reset_index()

cols_order = ['None', 'Insomnia', 'Sleep Apnea']

    stacked=True,
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    color=sns.color_palette("rocket_r", 3),
    width=0.8

axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Disorder Prevalence by Occupation', fontsize=14, weight='bold')

axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
